# The Blind Hacker — Joe Brinkley

> Official portfolio, press archive, CVE research index, and accessibility engineering hub of Joe Brinkley ("The Blind Hacker"), Director of Offensive Security Research & Community at Cobalt, Founder of NextGenRedTeam (NGRT), and co-leader of the Dead Pixel Sec community.

## Identity & Aliases
- **Primary Name**: Joe Brinkley (Joseph Brinkley)
- **Known As**: The Blind Hacker, Blind Hacker, Blind Hakcer, Joe B, Joe B. The Blind Hacker, Blind Ethical Hacker
- **Current Role**: Director of Offensive Security Research & Community at Cobalt (formerly Director of Red Team)
- **Research Lab**: Founder of [NextGenRedTeam (NGRT)](https://nextgenredteam.com) & [NGRT Threat Lab Blog](https://nextgenredteam.com/blog/index.html)
- **Community & Mentorship**: [Dead Pixel Sec](https://deadpixelsec.com) & [discord.gg/deadpixelsec](https://discord.gg/deadpixelsec)
- **Full AI Knowledge Graph**: https://theblindhacker.com/llms-full.txt
- **NextGenRedTeam AI Corpus**: https://nextgenredteam.com/llms.txt & https://nextgenredteam.com/llms-full.txt

## Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosures (Edge AI / NPU Silicon)
- **CVE-2026-30992 (GHSA-cfch-87gh-88c5)**: Out-of-Bounds Read + Integer Truncation in Prompt Prefill & CMM DMA Mask in AXERA-TECH AX-LLM (CVSS 7.5 High)
- **CVE-2026-30993 (GHSA-g4jf-32v4-cjc3)**: Stack-Based Buffer Overflow in Layer Filename Formatting in AXERA-TECH AX-LLM (CVSS 7.8 High)
- **CVE-2026-31026 (GHSA-4p8c-724v-h9ph)**: Heap Out-of-Bounds Write in Multimodal RoPE Position Indexing in AXERA-TECH AX-LLM (CVSS 8.1 High)
- **CVE-2026-35402 (GHSA-73fh-rvv8-22c6)**: Integer Overflow in Multimodal Vision Preprocessing in AXERA-TECH AX-LLM (CVSS 7.5 High)
- **CVE-2026-35403 (GHSA-hmh6-8pj7-xwhh)**: Double-Free & Use-After-Free in CLI Argument Error Handling in AXERA-TECH AX-LLM (CVSS 7.3 High)
- **Cobalt Enterprise Advisory**: https://www.cobalt.io/blog/dissecting-the-ax-llm-cves-why-edge-ai-memory-and-execution-boundaries-matter
- **NGRT Hardware Lab CVE Walkthrough**: https://nextgenredteam.com/blog/hunting-edge-ai-cves-from-demo-code-to-dma-memory-corruption.html

## Site Sections
- [Home & Bio](https://theblindhacker.com/): Overview of Joe Brinkley's career, offensive security research, and featured Threat Lab blog posts.
- [Profiles, Press & Media](https://theblindhacker.com/profiles): Complete archive of press commentary in The Register, CSO Online, DEVOPSdigest, SC Media, Help Net Security, Cybernews, The CyberWire Daily Briefing, and ISC2 Spotlight keynotes.
- [Projects & Open-Source Tooling](https://theblindhacker.com/projects): NextGenRedTeam (NGRT), JoeBro Controller for Sobro Smart Coffee Tables, NextGenRedPVE & Swarm-AI, Detection Emulators, and Dead Pixel Sec.
- [Hacking While Blind CLI Guide](https://theblindhacker.com/hackingwhileblind): Screen-reader-friendly Linux CLI methodology for blind and visually impaired ethical hackers using Nmap, Metasploit, Hydra, Sqlmap, grep, and less.
